text.autoconfig.relicex.title: RelicEx Config Options
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.chestsHav: Chest loot generates with RelicEx items if true.
Chance for a chest's loot to contain a Relic.
Chest Loot is Lesser Orb of Regret
Chance for a chest's loot to contain a Lesser Orb of Regret.
Chest Loot is Greater Orb of Regret
Chance for a chest's loot to contain a Greater Orb of Regret.
Chance for a chest's loot to contain a Tome.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.dragonDro: If true the Ender Dragon will drop a Dragon Stone on death.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.mobsDropL: The chance for mobs to drop RelicEx loot.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.dropsOnly: If true mobs will drop RelicEx loot only if death was by a player.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.mobDropIs: The chance for a RelicEx mob drop to be a Relic.
The chance for a RelicEx mob drop to be a Health Potion.
Mob Drop is Lesser Orb of Regret
The chance for a RelicEx mob drop to be a Lesser Orb of Regret.
Mob Drop is Greater Orb of Regret
The chance for a RelicEx mob drop to be a Greater Orb of Regret.
The chance for a RelicEx mob drop to be a Tome.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.mobDropBl: Entity types in this list will not drop relics/health potions.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.enableDim: Enable different relic rarities and drop chances for different dimensions.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.overworld: Rarity settings for the Overworld dimension.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.netherSet: Rarity settings for the Nether dimension.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.endSettin: Rarity settings for the End dimension.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.customDim: Rarity settings for custom modded dimensions.
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.Dimension: Minimum rarity percentage for relics in this dimension (0-100%).
Maximum rarity percentage for relics in this dimension (0-100%).
The namespace:name identifier of the dimension (e.g., minecraft:overworld).
Multiplier for relic drop chances in this dimension (100% = normal, 200% = double chance).
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.overworld: Minimum rarity percentage for relics in the Overworld (0-100%).
Maximum rarity percentage for relics in the Overworld (0-100%).
The namespace:name identifier of the Overworld (e.g., minecraft:overworld).
Multiplier for relic drop chances in the Overworld (100% = normal, 200% = double chance).
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.netherSet: Minimum rarity percentage for relics in the Nether (0-100%).
Maximum rarity percentage for relics in the Nether (0-100%).
The namespace:name identifier of the Nether (e.g., minecraft:overworld).
Multiplier for relic drop chances in the Nether (100% = normal, 200% = double chance).
text.autoconfig.relicex.option.endSettin: Minimum rarity percentage for relics in The End (0-100%).
Maximum rarity percentage for relics in The End (0-100%).
The namespace:name identifier of The End (e.g., minecraft:overworld).
Multiplier for relic drop chances in The End (100% = normal, 200% = double chance).
